title: Nate's Remarkably Optimized
description: The Remarkably Optimized modpack with extras added into it
body:
This is based on the Remarkably Optimized mod pack. That is essentially what this is but with added shaders, resource packs, and mods!!

I put this together because I wanted a version that felt a little more alive and personal. The base pack already does a great job at keeping things running smoothly, so I built on top of that and added some visual upgrades and extra content to make it feel more like my own setup.

Whether you are just getting into modded Minecraft or you have been playing for years, this should give you a solid and enjoyable experience. Everything is tuned to work well together so you are not running into a bunch of conflicts or random crashes. Just load it up and have fun with it!

Remarkably Optimized: https://modrinth.com/modpack/remarkably
